breaking.change: The places gained are named by one plural string each: racing.lap.up and racing.lap.down are now ICU plurals ({n, plural, one {Up # place} other {Up # places}}), and the racing.lap.upOne and racing.lap.downOne strings are removed.
breaking.fix: A game that overrode racing.lap.upOne or racing.lap.downOne puts its one-place wording into the one branch of its racing.lap.up or racing.lap.down plural instead.
